decisions.reason: As a safety shoe line closely related to the firm’s existing protective footwear expertise, its early website presence and absorptive capacity support continued learning.
The comfort insole benefits from the firm’s foot-measurement and footwear comfort knowledge, so it can interpret early results and improve without high drop risk.
Although supportive insoles require more specialised orthotic knowledge, the firm’s foot-measurement tools and in-house specialists allow it to assimilate feedback and improve.
The ergonomic safety shoe series directly extends the firm’s core safety footwear capabilities and its dedicated webpage indicates strong internal commitment and low drop likelihood.

Firefighter and rescue boots are adjacent but demand new certification and high-performance material knowledge; the firm can build absorptive capacity through its R&D, so it is likely kept but with moderate uncertainty.
As the moulded insole is the stated flagship and shown on the home page, the firm will invest in the related production and design knowledge needed, making early withdrawal unlikely.
